# Vendor Security Standard

## Risk tiers
Vendors are assigned one of three risk tiers: low, medium and high.

## Reviews
Vendors that process personal data receive a security review every 24 months.

## Evidence
Critical vendors must provide a SOC 2 Type II report or an ISO 27001 certificate.
